sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Compaore hosts Ivorian peace talks
geopolitical_news.summary: Ouagadougou becomes the venue for negotiations to end Ivory Coast's civil conflict.

geopolitical_news.headline: Gold mining boom begins
geopolitical_news.summary: New mines open as Burkina Faso emerges as a growing gold producer.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso miss 2006 World Cup
sport.summary: The Stallions fall short in qualifying for Germany 2006.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ouagadougou peace deal signed for Ivory Coast
geopolitical_news.summary: March's agreement, brokered by Compaore, brings rebels into Ivory Coast's government.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ruling party wins legislative vote
geopolitical_news.summary: Compaore's CDP takes May's parliamentary elections.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso miss 2008 AFCON
sport.summary: The Stallions fail to qualify for the Ghana tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Food price riots hit Ouagadougou
geopolitical_news.summary: February protests over living costs turn violent in the capital.

geopolitical_news.headline: Government reshuffles cabinet
geopolitical_news.summary: Compaore changes ministers in response to the unrest.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso compete at Beijing Olympics
sport.summary: Burkinabe athletes take part in the 2008 Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Floods devastate Ouagadougou
geopolitical_news.summary: September deluges kill several people and displace thousands in the capital.

geopolitical_news.headline: Gold boom transforms economy
geopolitical_news.summary: Mining overtakes cotton as Burkina Faso's top export earner.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso qualify for 2010 AFCON
sport.summary: The Stallions book a place at the Angola tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Compaore re-elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: The incumbent wins November's vote amid opposition fraud claims.

geopolitical_news.headline: Burkina mediates Guinea's transition
geopolitical_news.summary: Compaore brokers the Ouagadougou accords guiding Guinea toward elections.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso exit AFCON at group stage
sport.summary: The Stallions go home early from the 2010 tournament in Angola.

geopolitical_news.headline: Army mutinies shake the regime
geopolitical_news.summary: Months of soldier revolts over pay rattle Compaore's two-decade rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: Protests spread beyond the barracks
geopolitical_news.summary: Students and traders join demonstrations against the cost of living.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso qualify for 2012 AFCON
sport.summary: The Stallions reach the Gabon-Equatorial Guinea tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ruling party wins legislative elections
geopolitical_news.summary: Compaore's CDP takes December's parliamentary vote.

geopolitical_news.headline: Burkina mediates in Mali crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: Compaore leads ECOWAS efforts as northern Mali falls to rebels and jihadists.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso exit AFCON winless
sport.summary: Three defeats at the 2012 tournament send the Stallions home bottom of their group.

geopolitical_news.headline: Senate plan sparks protests
geopolitical_news.summary: Opposition marches denounce a new senate seen as a ploy to extend Compaore's rule.

geopolitical_news.headline: Burkina contributes troops to Mali
geopolitical_news.summary: Burkinabe soldiers join the African force fighting Islamists in northern Mali.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso reach AFCON final
sport.summary: A penalty shootout win over Ghana takes the Stallions to the final, lost 1-0 to Nigeria.

geopolitical_news.headline: Popular uprising ousts Compaore
geopolitical_news.summary: Hundreds of thousands march in October; parliament is torched and the president flees to Ivory Coast.

geopolitical_news.headline: Military seizes power
geopolitical_news.summary: The army takes over after Compaore's fall, promising a civilian transition.

geopolitical_news.headline: Transitional government formed
geopolitical_news.summary: Diplomat Michel Kafando is named interim president in November under a transition charter.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso lose World Cup playoff
sport.summary: Algeria edge the Stallions on away goals to deny them a first World Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: Coup attempt fails
geopolitical_news.summary: General Diendere's September power grab collapses within a week under popular and regional pressure.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kabore wins presidential election
geopolitical_news.summary: Roch Kabore wins November's vote, completing the return to civilian rule.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso exit AFCON at group stage
sport.summary: The Stallions finish bottom of their group at the 2015 tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ouagadougou hotel attack kills dozens
geopolitical_news.summary: AQIM gunmen storm the Splendid Hotel in January in the capital's worst terror attack.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kabore inaugurated president
geopolitical_news.summary: The new president takes office promising security and reconciliation.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso compete at Rio Olympics
sport.summary: Burkinabe athletes take part in the Rio 2016 Games.

geopolitical_news.headline: Restaurant attack hits Ouagadougou
geopolitical_news.summary: Gunmen kill diners at a Turkish restaurant in August in a second major capital attack.

geopolitical_news.headline: Jihadist insurgency spreads
geopolitical_news.summary: Violence escalates in the north as militant groups multiply.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso win AFCON bronze
sport.summary: Victory over Ghana in the third-place match caps the Stallions' best AFCON since 2013.

geopolitical_news.headline: Twin attacks hit army HQ and French embassy
geopolitical_news.summary: Coordinated March assaults in Ouagadougou kill several soldiers and attackers.

geopolitical_news.headline: Insurgency worsens in the north
geopolitical_news.summary: Jihadist ambushes displace tens of thousands in the Sahel region.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso miss 2018 World Cup
sport.summary: The Stallions fall short in qualifying for Russia 2018.

geopolitical_news.headline: Jihadist violence escalates sharply
geopolitical_news.summary: Massacres of civilians mount as the state loses control of rural areas.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kabore under growing pressure
geopolitical_news.summary: Opposition and citizens demand action as insecurity dominates politics.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso miss 2019 AFCON
sport.summary: The Stallions fail to qualify for the Egypt tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Kabore re-elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: The incumbent wins November's vote despite the raging insurgency.

geopolitical_news.headline: Displacement crisis deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: More than a million Burkinabe flee jihadist violence.

sport.headline: Football suspended by pandemic
sport.summary: Burkina Faso's leagues halt for months amid COVID-19.

geopolitical_news.headline: Inata massacre kills dozens of gendarmes
geopolitical_news.summary: A November jihadist raid on a northern outpost becomes one of the army's deadliest losses.

geopolitical_news.headline: Coup rumors swirl around Kabore
geopolitical_news.summary: Growing military discontent fuels speculation of a putsch.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso qualify for 2021 AFCON
sport.summary: The Stallions reach the Cameroon tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Damiba ousts Kabore in January coup
geopolitical_news.summary: Soldiers seize power on January 24, citing failure to stop the insurgency.

geopolitical_news.headline: Traore ousts Damiba in September coup
geopolitical_news.summary: Captain Ibrahim Traore takes power in a second putsch within eight months.

geopolitical_news.headline: Junta pivots toward Russia
geopolitical_news.summary: Ouagadougou expels French forces and deepens ties with Moscow.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso reach AFCON semifinals
sport.summary: A run to the last four in Cameroon ends with defeat to Senegal.

geopolitical_news.headline: French troops complete withdrawal
geopolitical_news.summary: The last French soldiers leave in February at the junta's demand.

geopolitical_news.headline: Burkina, Mali, Niger form AES alliance
geopolitical_news.summary: September's Liptako-Gourma charter creates a Sahel states mutual-defense pact.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso qualify for 2023 AFCON
sport.summary: The Stallions book a place at the Ivory Coast tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: AES states quit ECOWAS
geopolitical_news.summary: Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger announce their joint withdrawal in January.

geopolitical_news.headline: Junta extends transition by five years
geopolitical_news.summary: May's national dialogue allows Traore to remain in power until 2029.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso exit AFCON in round of 16
sport.summary: A 2-1 defeat to Mali ends the Stallions' 2023 campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: AES confederation takes shape
geopolitical_news.summary: The Sahel alliance deepens integration with joint institutions and a common passport.

geopolitical_news.headline: Jihadist attacks continue unabated
geopolitical_news.summary: Large-scale raids on towns and military bases persist across the north and east.

sport.headline: Burkina Faso qualify for 2025 AFCON
sport.summary: The Stallions secure a place at the Morocco tournament.
